settings.privacy_gdpr_text:
Euro Habesha operates strictly under European General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) standards.

• Your personal information, phone number, and listings are fully encrypted and secured.
• We do not share your data with third-party advertising networks.
• You have the full right to export or permanently delete your data at any time through your profile settings.
